sokkel-egui.note: Drawn from the spec: the plain stat (dot, unit, change, note, trend) and the tile, a control only with href or selectable; a value is never cut.

sokkel-tui.note: Not in sokkel-tui's reports as of b99664f.

summary: One number with what it counts: runs today, the failure rate, the median duration. A change against an earlier period stands beside it, inked by whether the change is good, which the app says, since a rise in failures and a rise in runs mean opposite things. A state's dot may lead the label; as a tile it stands on a card of its own and may be one control that goes to what it counts; emphasis edges the one tile that asks for work in its dot's color, and size lg draws the one hero figure larger than its neighbors.

anatomy.container: A column, 4 apart. As a tile: on card with a border-strong edge, rounded by radius-surface, padded 16, in card-foreground; with href or onSelect the whole tile is one control under its pieces.
anatomy.label: What it counts, cut to one line, after the dot (8 apart): plain, text.xs in muted-foreground; as a tile, text.label in foreground.
anatomy.dot: With dot: the color the app gives (a status's), small in plain, large in a tile.
anatomy.value: The number in tabular figures, its unit and the change after it on one baseline, 8 apart; 4 more above it in a tile. plain: text.page at 500; tile: text.statistic; lg: text.statistic-hero.
anatomy.change: With change: an arrow up and right (or down and right for a change written with a minus), 14, then the change, text.xs at 450 in tabular figures, 2 apart: muted-foreground when good is not given, good when good, critical when not.
anatomy.note: With note: under the number; plain, text.xs in faint; in a tile, text.help in muted-foreground, wrapping evenly.
anatomy.trend: With trend: a small chart under the number, such as a sparkline, 8 below it in all: the column's gap of 4 and 4 more.

change.does: The change written for a reader: +12%, -0.4s; a minus turns the arrow down.

good.does: Whether the change is an improvement; neutral when not given.

note.does: A short qualifier under the number: vs last week.

trend.does: A small chart under the number, such as a sparkline.

dot.does: A color drawn as a dot before the label, such as a status's.

variant.does: plain sits in whatever holds it; tile is a card of its own.

href.does: Where the tile leads, such as a list filtered to what it counts.

onSelect.does: Called on a press on the tile.

emphasis.does: Edges the tile in its dot's color at 55 percent alpha, <dot>/55 (status-failed/55 for a failed dot), as primary/80 is primary at 80: the count that asks for work. The dot is a color the app gives, so no paint resolves it; a renderer draws the dot's color at that alpha.

size.does: lg draws the number at text.statistic-hero: the one hero figure, larger than its neighbors.

md.note: A tile's number; plain, text.page at 500.

rest.means: The number and what it counts; a change neutral.

good.means: The change is an improvement: in good.

bad.means: The change is a setback: in critical.

hover.means: The pointer is over a tile that is a control: washed, its edge firmer.
hover.reached: pointer over, with href or onSelect

focus.means: Keyboard focus on the tile: the focus outline around it.

rest.note: No ground of its own: the ground it stands on.
plain; in a tile text.label in foreground.
plain; a tile text.statistic, lg text.statistic-hero.
plain; in a tile text.help in muted-foreground.

keyboard.does: Reaches the tile when it is a control.

sokkel-ui: With href or onSelect a link or a button covers the tile, named by the label and the value; the pieces over it let the pointer through.

drift.today: As of b99664f its reports name no such part.
